question: Find the length of a tangent drawn to a circle with radius 8 cm from a point 17 cm from the centre of the circle,
solution:
**Given :**

The radius of the circle OA = 8 cm

Distance of the point from the center of the circle OP = 17 cm

**Concept Used :**

The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

**Calculation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1edf658fc7b4f82ddf20c72f5d29bd958bad152eece7bbb0e2b2358cc524786.png] 

In right-angled Δ OAP using the Pythagorean theorem, OP² = OA² + PA²

⇒ 17² = 8² + PA²

⇒ 289 - 64 = PA²

⇒ 15² = PA²

⇒ 15 = PA

**∴ The length of tangent = 15 cm.**
